purpose: SAM3 Triton sigmoid focal loss has a backward NaN bug when gamma==0 (as used by the presence focal loss, presence_gamma default 0.0). The Triton backward computes (1 - p_t) ** (gamma - 1) = (1 - p_t) ** -1, which is Inf once a confident presence logit saturates p_t -> 1; the subsequent 0 * Inf = NaN yields a FINITE forward/loss but a NaN gradient that back-propagates through the decoder, encoder and both backbones (reproduced on this box: gamma=0, logits +/-18 -> loss finite, grad NaN). This patch routes gamma == 0 to the numerically-finite PyTorch focal-loss path (the modulating factor is identically 1 there, and 0 * finite = 0); gamma != 0 keeps the Triton path unchanged. Forward loss value is identical (verified). This is the ORIGINAL source of the bad gradients that the bf16-GradScaler and GRAD-GUARD patches only contained/amplified downstream. Aligns with SAM3 issue #575 / PR #484. Target: sam3/train/loss/loss_fns.py sigmoid_focal_loss().
